borrows: concept-as-working-object metaphor (the machine IS the explanation)
isometric solids with four-tone shading, halo under base, 0.6px lines, one lit accent
framed card: Fig n / title / hint / live readout in the four corners
calm eased motion (exponential follow, real springs, idle tour)
every number from one small model that also drives the parts
self-verification by zooming into every joint (line ends, painter's order, audit)

line: Explain a concept by building it as a real, working isometric machine of dozens of small shaded parts, in a framed card with a figure number, a hint and a live readout driven by the same model.
line_cn: 把概念造成一台真实可运转的等轴测小机器：几十个带明暗的零件、Fig 图题框卡、实时读数与零件同源，缓慢惯性运动。
